import json

# Build a comprehensive markdown report
def format_product(pid, p):
    lines = []
    lines.append(f"## {p.get('name', 'Unknown')} ({pid})")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append(f"- **Price:** ${p.get('price', 'N/A')}")
    if p.get('price_drop'):
        lines.append(f"  - 🔻 Recent price drop: {p['price_drop']}")
    lines.append(f"- **Category:** {p.get('category', 'N/A')}")
    lines.append(f"- **Rating:** {p.get('rating', 'N/A')}★")
    lines.append(f"- **In Stock:** {'Yes' if p.get('in_stock') else 'No'} ({p.get('stock', 'N/A')} units)")
    lines.append(f"- **Shipping Days:** {p.get('shipping_days', 'N/A')}")
    lines.append(f"- **Gift Wrap Available:** {'Yes' if p.get('gift_wrap_available') else 'No'}")
    lines.append("")
    if p.get('description'):
        lines.append(f"**Description:** {p['description']}")
        lines.append("")
    if p.get('specs'):
        lines.append("**Specifications:**")
        if isinstance(p['specs'], dict):
            for k, v in p['specs'].items():
                lines.append(f"  - {k}: {v}")
        else:
            lines.append(f"  {p['specs']}")
        lines.append("")
    if p.get('compatible_with'):
        lines.append(f"**Compatible With:** {', '.join(p['compatible_with']) if isinstance(p['compatible_with'], list) else p['compatible_with']}")
        lines.append("")
    if p.get('variants'):
        lines.append(f"**Variants:** {p['variants']}")
        lines.append("")
    return '\n'.join(lines)
